import sys

def solve():
    input = sys.stdin.readline

    n, q = map(int, input().split())
    s = list(input().strip())

    # 1-indexed positions of '(' and ')'
    opens = set()
    closes = set()
    for i, ch in enumerate(s, 1):
        if ch == '(':
            opens.add(i)
        else:
            closes.add(i)

    out = []

    for _ in range(q):
        x = int(input())
        x0 = x - 1

        if s[x0] == '(':
            # Flip this '(' -> ')'
            s[x0] = ')'
            opens.remove(x)
            closes.add(x)

            # To restore balance, flip the leftmost ')' to '('
            y = min(closes)
            s[y - 1] = '('
            closes.remove(y)
            opens.add(y)
            out.append(str(y))
        else:
            # Flip this ')' -> '('
            s[x0] = '('
            closes.remove(x)
            opens.add(x)

            # To restore balance, flip the rightmost '(' to ')'
            y = max(opens)
            s[y - 1] = ')'
            opens.remove(y)
            closes.add(y)
            out.append(str(y))

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
